card.name: Ends of units and abbreviations in dosing tables
card.fires_on: The last piece of a unit or abbreviation in dose-adjustment tables, such as the L in x 10 9/L or mg/dL, the N in ULN, or the % after a number.

modes.label: Lab unit endings
modes.description: The final L of a unit like /L or mg/dL in lab thresholds for dose changes.

modes.label: Abbreviation endings
modes.description: The last letters of an abbreviation such as ULN or MRI, or a percent sign after a number.
